Ten other players have won the World Cup, Champions League and Ballon d’Or with Rodri become the 11th and first Spaniard to do so. Germany legends Franz Beckenbauer and Gerd Muller and France great Zinedine Zidane have also won a domestic league title and the European Championships. Brazil’s Rivaldo and Ronaldinho and Argentina’s Lionel Messi have also won a domestic league title and the Copa America – the South American championship.
